migrate.completedHint: Downtime {{seconds}} seconds. The source has been cleaned up.
migrate.estimate: About {{size}} of data; expected cutover downtime about {{seconds}} seconds.

migrate.holdingHint_other: {{server}} keeps the locked old copy for {{count}} more days, until {{date}}. You can roll back until then; afterwards the panel cleans up the source.

terminated.title: Terminated accounts
terminated.description: Data is kept at least 30 days. Purging needs a verified final backup and two different Super Admins: one schedules, the other confirms.
terminated.policy: 1. Super Admin A schedules the purge: the panel takes a final backup and verifies it (restic check + test restore). 2. Once the retention period ends, Super Admin B types the username to confirm and the purge runs immediately. Accounts under legal hold can't be purged.

terminated.needVerified: Waiting for the final snapshot to pass a restore test
terminated.notDue: Can be confirmed after {{date}} (end of retention)

dns.addZoneHint: The zone must already exist in the provider's Cloudflare account. The panel reads all records right after attaching.
dns.zoneAccountHint: The zone is linked to an account within your scope.
dns.zoneAccountHintSa: Choose a hosting account, or System for the panel's own zone.
dns.removeZoneHint: The panel stops managing this zone. The zone and its records on Cloudflare stay as they are and can be attached again later.

cron.title: Cron jobs
cron.description: Scheduled commands running as the hosting account UID. The package sets the job count and minimum interval.
cron.scheduleHint: Five fields: minute hour day month weekday (server time, Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh).
cron.commandHint: Single line; runs in the working folder as the account UID.
cron.formHint: Preview the next five runs before saving.

wp.title: WordPress
wp.description: WordPress sites on PHP websites: selective updates with a snapshot and automatic rollback on failure, hardening, staging, maintenance.
wp.installHint: The panel creates a database + user within the package, then installs WordPress. The admin password is shown once, right after you submit.

confirmHint.update: The panel backs up the site, then updates core, plugins and themes. Restore from the backup if something breaks.
confirmHint.harden: Disables XML-RPC and file editing in wp-admin, rate-limits logins and blocks PHP in uploads.
confirmHint.clone-staging: Creates staging.<domain> (counts toward the package website limit) with a copy of files and database.

wp.adminPasswordHint: The password goes through the agent vault and is never stored in the job or audit log. Requires re-authentication.
wp.autoSafety: Every automatic update takes a snapshot first and rolls back if the homepage fails afterwards.
wp.autoUpdateHint: Runs inside the server's time window.
wp.basicAuthLater: Not available in this version. Staging sets noindex by default so search engines do not index it.
wp.componentsHint: Pick components with updates to apply.
wp.confirmSelectedHint: Steps: snapshot → maintenance on → update → homepage check. If the check fails, the panel restores files and database from the snapshot.
wp.hardeningHint: Applied via WP-CLI under the account UID and Nginx rules.
wp.historyHint: Each update keeps a snapshot for restore.
wp.lastRolledBack: The last update was rolled back
wp.lastRolledBackHint: At {{at}}. See the Updates tab for the error and the failing component.
wp.maintenanceHint: Visitors see a maintenance page; logged-in administrators still get in.
wp.stagingHint: Copies files and database to a new subdomain and rewrites URLs in the database.
wp.stagingQuota: The staging copy counts toward the package's website quota.
wp.updating: Updating; the site is in maintenance mode.

xmlrpc_blocked.title: Block XML-RPC
xmlrpc_blocked.hint: Nginx returns 403 for xmlrpc.php (reduces brute force and pingbacks).

php_in_uploads_blocked.title: Block PHP in uploads
php_in_uploads_blocked.hint: Nginx won't pass .php files in wp-content/uploads to PHP-FPM.

wp_config_protected.title: Protect wp-config.php
wp_config_protected.hint: Mode 0400 and blocked from the web.

version_hidden.title: Hide WordPress version
version_hidden.hint: Removes the generator tag and readme.html.

salts_rotated.title: Rotate security keys (salts)
salts_rotated.hint: Generates new keys; all current sessions are logged out.

git.title: Git deploy
git.description: Deploy websites from Git: each deploy is a new release switched by symlink, and rolling back takes seconds. Builds run as the account UID.
git.connectHint: After connecting, add the read-only deploy key to the repository, then press Deploy.
git.emptyHint: Connect a website to a Git repository to deploy by release.
git.repoHint: Keeps the {{keep}} latest releases for rollback.
git.disconnectHint: The current release keeps running; you just cannot deploy from Git anymore.
git.autoDeployHint: Requires a webhook at the Git provider with the panel URL and secret.
git.buildHint: Single line, runs in the release folder as the account UID.
git.sharedHint: One path per line kept across releases (e.g. .env, storage).
git.deployKey: Deploy key (add to the repository, read-only)
git.rollbackHint: The symlink switches to the old release and PHP-FPM reloads; the database is untouched.

sec.title: Security
sec.description: Security score, checks and events from WAF, fail2ban, FIM and malware scans on the servers in your scope.
sec.checksHint: “Fail” items lower the score the most; fix them by severity.

check.waf_all_sites: WAF on for every PHP website

sec.wafDescription: ModSecurity + OWASP CRS per PHP website. Toggle here; mode, paranoia level and rule exclusions live in the website WAF tab.
sec.wafRecentHint: waf.block events from every website in scope.
sec.malwareDescription: ClamAV + YARA scan website files as the account UID. Suspicious files are quarantined, not deleted.
sec.scanHint: The job runs on the website server; results appear in the list when done.
sec.quarantineHint: Files moved out of the website, kept intact for investigation or restore on false positives.
sec.restoreHint: File {{path}} will be put back into the website. Only do this when sure it is a false positive.
sec.sshDescription: sshd configuration for the panel server. Applied through the agent (sshd -t before reload), never by hand.
sec.sshPortHint: Open the new port in the firewall before changing.
sec.allowGroupsHint: Linux group names, comma separated. Hosting accounts with SSH in their package are added automatically.
sec.sshWarn: Keep an SSH session open while changing the port or groups. The panel refuses an empty group list.
sec.viaAgentHint: Changes run as an sshd.config.apply job with syntax check and audit log.
sec.f2bDescription: Bans IPs brute-forcing SSH and portal login. Banned counts are reported by fail2ban.
sec.jailsHint: Each jail watches one log source.
sec.fimDescription: Detects system files changed outside the panel. Changes applied by the panel update the baseline and are not reported.
sec.fimWatchedHint: SHA-256 compared against the baseline every 15 minutes.
sec.allowDescription: Only these IP ranges can open the Admin Panel. The user portal is not restricted.
sec.myIpOk: Your IP ({{ip}}) is in the list
sec.myIpOut: Your IP ({{ip}}) is not in the list
sec.myIpOutHint: Saving this list will lock you out of the Admin Panel. Add a range containing your IP first.

errors.groups: At least one group is required
errors.group: Group names: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; start with a letter
errors.allowEmpty: At least one IP range is required

sec.sshAwaitingHint_one: Open a new SSH session to test. {{count}} second left before automatic rollback.
sec.sshAwaitingHint_other: Open a new SSH session to test. {{count}} seconds left before automatic rollback.
sec.sshRolledBackHint: No confirmation arrived in time, so the agent restored the previous sshd config.
sec.sshNoKeys: Disabling password login now would lock you out. Add an SSH key for the admin user first.
sec.sshRollbackHint: 30 to 600 seconds. If you don't press “Keep new config” in time, the agent restores the old one.
sec.sshKeysHint: Keys of the admin user on the server (outside the panel). At least one is needed to disable passwords.
sec.fimRebaselineHint: The agent re-hashes every watched path and treats the current state as trusted. Only do this after reviewing changes. Requires MFA step-up.
sec.findingsHint: Recent scan results. Quarantine moves the file out of the website and keeps it for investigation.
sec.bansHint: Read live from fail2ban on the server.
sec.bansEmpty: No IP is banned right now.
sec.wafSiteEventsHint: Requests logged by ModSecurity, synced every minute.
sec.wafSiteEventsEmpty: No WAF events for this website yet.

bk.title: Backups
bk.description: Restic snapshots per account, scheduled policies, storage destinations and verification by test restores.
bk.historyHint: Each snapshot is an encrypted restic backup. Snapshots on immutable destinations cannot be deleted early.
bk.backupNowHint: Takes a manual snapshot of one account to the local destination; scheduled policies keep running.
bk.deleteHint: Runs restic forget + prune on the destination. This cannot be undone.
bk.linkHint: Signed link, expires at {{at}}. Share only with people who need it.
bk.verifyHint: Each account's latest snapshot must pass a test restore within {{days}} days.
bk.policiesHint: Cron-scheduled restic runs with daily/weekly/monthly retention; each run ends with check and forget.
bk.policyFormHint: Pick at least one immutable offsite destination to meet the 3-2-1-1-0 rule.
bk.deletePolicyHint: Existing snapshots are kept per destination retention.
bk.destinationsHint: Where restic repositories live. Credentials are encrypted and never shown again.
bk.appendOnlyHint: The server can only append, never delete old snapshots (ransomware protection).
bk.destFormHint: After saving, the panel runs restic check through the agent to confirm the destination works.
bk.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the current value
bk.objectLockHint: Snapshots cannot be deleted or changed for the set days, even with admin keys.
bk.lockNote_one: Object Lock is set to {{count}} day: it can only increase.
bk.lockNote_other: Object Lock is set to {{count}} days: it can only increase.

errors.contents: Choose at least one content type
errors.exclude: One path per line, relative to home (max 200 characters), not starting with / and without ..

bk.excludesHint: One pattern per line, relative to the account home, e.g. tmp/** or **/cache/**.
bk.retentionCliHint: {{names}} doesn't let the panel delete snapshots (Object Lock/append-only). Prune old ones with itso backup prune on the server, entering prune credentials there.
bk.reposHint: One restic repository per account with its own password; server config and panel live in the server repository.

quota.pausedHint: over 120%, scheduled backups paused (old ones kept)

bk.quotaHint: Account backup repository size against the package. Over quota: warning; over 120%: scheduled backups pause.
bk.sftpKeyHint: The agent generates a dedicated SSH key for this destination. After saving, add the public key to the user's authorized_keys on the target, then press Test (the host key is pinned on first contact).
bk.restHint: Use a rest-server user with append-only rights: the panel can write but never delete backups.
bk.kitFirstHint: Shown once. Store it somewhere safe off the server (safe, password manager) before closing.
bk.kitAgainHint: Viewing the recovery kit again. This view is audited.
bk.kitWarnTitle: This kit restores backups even if the panel is lost
bk.kitWarn: Anyone holding the kit can read every backup. Don't send it over chat or email, and don't keep it on this server.
bk.kitPanelKeyHint: Decrypts panel backups (panel DB, /etc/itso) during disaster recovery. The panel only keeps the public key.
bk.kitConfirm: I've stored the recovery kit safely off the server
bk.fileLinkHint: One-time download link for {{name}}, expires at {{at}}.

ov.destHint: Repository size on each destination (after restic dedup and compression).
ov.quotaHint: Accounts whose backups exceed their package.
ov.noQuota: Every account is within its backup quota.

vh.title: Verification history
vh.hint: Weekly restic check reads a random 5% of data; the monthly restore test restores into staging and compares sha256 with the manifest.

bk.localHint: Repositories live in {{path}} on the server (root only). A local disk is not off-site: add another S3/SFTP/rest-server destination.
bk.volumeConsistencyHint: Pause containers while snapshotting so data (e.g. databases) is not caught mid-write.

rs.title: Restores
rs.description: Restores from snapshots. Each restore runs as a job on the target server under the account UID.
rs.newDescription: Choose a snapshot, what to bring back and how. Prefer restoring to a new copy first and comparing.
rs.noSnapshots: This account has no snapshots yet.
rs.configHint: Vhosts, PHP-FPM pool, cron and SSL of the account

new.title: To a new copy
new.hint: Extracts files into backups/restore-<time>/ and databases into a new <name>_r<time>; running data is untouched.

overwrite.title: Overwrite live data
overwrite.hint: Replaces current files/databases with the snapshot. The panel takes a safety snapshot first.

rs.targetHint: You can restore to another server to test without touching the original.
rs.overwriteHint: Websites may be interrupted for a few minutes. Changes after the snapshot are lost (kept in the safety snapshot).
rs.reviewNew: The job runs on the target server; when done, the data sits next to the live copy for comparison.
rs.reviewOverwrite: The panel takes a safety snapshot before overwriting. Follow progress in the job drawer.

errors.items: Choose at least one item to restore
errors.overwriteOne: Overwrite: exactly one website (sites/<domain> folder) or one database at a time. Single files are always restored as a new copy.

rs.stepUpHint: Overwriting asks for your MFA code again. The panel dumps/snapshots the current data first; if anything fails midway the live data stays untouched.

outcome.config: reapply account config (vhost, PHP-FPM, cron, SSL)

users.title: Users
users.description: Administrator (Admin Panel) and portal user accounts. Every lock, MFA reset or impersonation is audited.
users.addHint: Users get an invite email to set a password; administrators must enable MFA at first login.
users.name: Name
users.sendInviteHint: The password link expires in 24 hours.

confirmHint.lock: All sessions are revoked immediately; websites and hosting keep running.
confirmHint.unlock: The user can log in again with their current password.
confirmHint.reset-mfa: The user must enroll an authenticator again at next login. Only do this after verifying their identity.

users.impHint: Opens the portal as this user for 30 minutes. They see a “being assisted” banner and the log records your name.
users.reasonHint: E.g. support ticket number, what to check. At least 5 characters.
users.impAudit: Every action in the session is logged with your name.
users.selfNote: This is your account: change password and MFA on the Profile page.
users.scopesHint: Assigning a server assigns every account on it.
users.noScopes: No scope assigned: this ADMIN sees no hosting data yet.
users.editScopesHint: Changes apply immediately to all of the user’s sessions.

errors.role: Role must match the account type

mon.title: Monitoring
mon.description: Server resources, website uptime checks and open alerts.
mon.uptimeHint: HTTP GET every minute from the panel server.
mon.offlineHint: No metrics received recently. The chart stops at the last sample.
mon.noData: No data for this range yet.
mon.servicesHint: Running or stopped, and since when.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Metric alert rules and alert history. Delivered by email, Telegram or in-panel.
alerts.deleteHint: Rules with firing alerts cannot be deleted; disable the rule first.
alerts.formHint: Alerts when the metric stays past the threshold for the set duration.
alerts.name: Rule name
alerts.defaultHint: Default rule: it cannot be deleted and its metric and scope are fixed. You can change the threshold, channels or disable it.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every write action in the panel, hash-chained to detect tampering. ADMIN only sees their own actions.
audit.chainNote: The hash chains to the previous row; editing a row breaks the chain.

notif.title: Notifications
notif.locked: Critical events always appear in the panel
notif.lockedHint: Critical events always appear in the panel; email and Telegram follow your choice.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: General panel settings, login security, mail server, API tokens and version.

hint.general: Display name and defaults for new users.
hint.security: Applies to every new login session.
hint.smtp: Used for invites, password resets and alerts.

settings.mfaLocked: Administrator MFA cannot be turned off in the UI.
settings.smtpSecret: The SMTP password lives in the server environment, never entered in the UI.
settings.tokensHint: Personal tokens for CLI/scripts. Shown once at creation; at most 1 year.
settings.addTokenHint: Only pick the permissions you need.
settings.revokeHint: Scripts using this token are rejected immediately.
settings.updateNote: Update the panel via the runbook; no self-update from the UI.
settings.captchaHint: After this many failures (per email or IP), Portal sign-in requires the self-hosted CAPTCHA. 0 = always required. Admin sign-in uses progressive lockout and MFA instead.
settings.portalMfaHint: Customers without MFA are sent to their profile to enable it right after sign-in.

pt.overviewHint: Usage against your plan quota, warnings and recent operations.
pt.noAccounts: You have no hosting plan yet
pt.noAccountsHint: Contact an administrator to get a hosting account.
pt.usageHint: Last measured by the server agent.
pt.accountHint: Plan {{name}}. Limits are set by administrators; contact them to upgrade.
pt.backupsHint: Backups of your hosting plans. Restores run as a job under the account UID.
pt.terminalHint: Account shell (no root access); every session is logged.
pt.noSsh: This hosting plan has no SSH access
pt.noSshHint: Use the File Manager or SFTP, or ask an administrator for a plan with SSH.
pt.forgotHint: Enter your sign-in email and we will send a reset link.
pt.forgotSentHint: If the email has an account, a reset link arrives within minutes. It expires in 30 minutes.
pt.securityHint: Web application firewall (WAF) for your websites and malware scanning for your accounts.
pt.wafNote: New websites run in “Detect only” for 7 days to avoid false positives, then an admin switches them to “Blocking”. Contact an admin if legitimate requests are blocked.
pt.findingsHint: You can quarantine or delete files. To restore a quarantined file, contact an admin.
pt.deleteFileHint: Permanently delete {{path}} from the account. This cannot be undone (except from backups).
pt.migratingTitle: This account is being moved to a new server
pt.migratingHint: Websites keep running during the move, but the account is read-only for now: creating, editing and deleting are refused. Everything works as before once the move finishes.

migrations.title: Server migrations
migrations.description: Account moves between servers in your scope: syncing, waiting for cutover, holding the source and finished.

accUsage.title: Account usage
accUsage.description: CPU, RAM, I/O and disk per hosting account from cgroups, sampled every 5 minutes.

uptime.title: Uptime checks
uptime.description: HTTP checks on each website's own domain, run by the server agent.
uptime.formHint: Only a path on the website's domain can be checked; arbitrary URLs are not allowed.
uptime.keywordHint: Down if the page does not contain it

errors.path: Path must start with / and contain only URL characters

channels.title: Notification channels
channels.description: Email, Telegram and webhook destinations for alerts. Secrets are encrypted and never shown again.
channels.formHint: Webhooks are signed with HMAC-SHA256; private network targets are blocked unless allowed.
channels.name: Name
channels.recipientsHint: Up to 20 addresses, separated by commas
channels.allowPrivateHint: Only for internal services (10.x, 192.168.x). Loopback and metadata addresses are always blocked.
channels.privateWarn: This webhook may reach internal services. Use only for trusted internal endpoints.
channels.secretKeep: Leave blank to keep the current secret.
channels.deleteHint: Rules using this channel stop sending to it.
channels.testOkHint: Check the destination for the test message.

errors.chatId: Enter a numeric chat ID or @channel name
errors.url: Use an https:// URL (http:// only with private network allowed)

deliveries.title: Delivery log
deliveries.description: Outgoing notifications: failures, retries, SSRF blocks and manual resend.

pmon.title: Monitoring
pmon.description: Resource usage of your hosting accounts and uptime of your websites.
pmon.uptimeHint: Checks are set up by your administrator; you can pause or resume them.
pmon.noChecks: No uptime checks for this account yet.
